platform: SolidEdge Cloud Platform (SECP) — Engineering Truth OS

gaps.title: Absence of Canonical QualificationRequirement Schema with Design & Evidence Traceability
gaps.description: Implemented `src/engine/qualification/QualificationRequirement.ts` with formal standard attribution, criticality, verification methods, acceptance criteria algebra, and canonical design references.

gaps.title: System-Level Root Entity Unifying Subsystems (ECU Reference Assembly)
gaps.description: Implemented `src/engine/qualification/EngineeringSystemCanonicalModel.ts` and `createReferenceEcuSystem()` (SECP-REF-ECU-001) defining full operating envelope, multidomain assembly, qualification requirements, and explicit solver validity envelope.

gaps.title: Lumped Theta-JA Thermal Model Conflation Risk
gaps.description: Thermal calculations use 1D Theta-JA lumped parameter thermal equations. Bounded explicitly as 0D/1D steady-state in solver validity limits; 3D CFD air-flow modeling is declared NOT_PROVEN.
gaps.impact: Controlled via explicit NOT_PROVEN disclosure in qualification reports.
gaps.remediationPlan: Maintained in solver-validity-register.json; 3D CFD remains NOT_PROVEN.

gaps.title: Unintegrated Structural Vibration & Dynamic Shock Solvers
gaps.description: FEA solvers under `src/engine/fem` exist in isolation. Dynamic vibration (MIL-STD-810H) and shock are formally declared NOT_PROVEN; only rigid kinematic clearances are verified.
gaps.impact: Dynamic vibration and shock survival cannot be claimed without external FEA/lab tests.

gaps.title: Lack of Quantitative Hardware FMEA / FMECA and Fault Tree Engine
gaps.description: Hardware failure rates (FIT) and single-point fault metrics (SPFM) are not yet computed from canonical components. Regulatory ASIL D / DAL A ratings remain NOT_PROVEN.
gaps.impact: Mandatory NOT_PROVEN verdict for external regulatory certifications.

gaps.phaseSubstage: P5.7 — Multidomain Failure Propagation & Evidence Invalidation
gaps.title: Automated Cross-Domain Revision Invalidation Cascade
gaps.description: Implemented `src/engine/qualification/QualificationChangeImpact.ts` which computes deterministic domain fingerprints, detects modifications, invalidates affected evidence, and triggers QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED.

gaps.title: Unified Evidence Record Alignment with Qualification Standard Clauses
gaps.description: Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) now links DO-254, IPC-6012, MIL-STD-810H, and SECP-CORE standard clauses directly to SHA-256 evidence digests and Merkle root.

gaps.title: Fail-Closed Qualification Release Gate
gaps.description: Implemented in `SystemQualificationEngine.ts`: emits QUALIFIED_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE only when 100% of requirements are verified and non-invalidated. Emits QUALIFICATION_BLOCKED or VERIFICATION_FAILED on any violation.
gaps.resolutionReference: Verified in system_qualification.test.ts (12/12 PASS) and qualification_adversarial.test.ts (10/10 PASS)
